display_name: The Three Hundred Martyrs of Africa

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Τριακόσιοι Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Αφρική», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι Τριακόσιοι Μάρτυρες μαρτύρησαν στην Αφρική τον 5ο αιώνα μετά Χριστόν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Ζήνωνα.» The page gives no year; the interval here is Zeno's reign, which the same day's entry for the two priests dates «(474 - 476 μ.Χ.)» and which is given on this page only as «στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Ζήνωνα».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Τριακόσιοι Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Αφρική»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company enumerates nobody — the page names only the two bishops who stirred up the persecution and the ruler who carried it out — so by the settled rule a company the page does not name is one folder. This page calls Kyrillos and Valinardis and the ruler Honorichos Monophysites, while the same day's entries for the two priests and the sixty priests call Honorichos an Arian; the disagreement is the source's own and is recorded rather than resolved. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.12.2025 (8. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици у Африци.“

attestations.note: The third of the three groups the day’s third entry counts: «три стотине мирјана посечени», three hundred LAYMEN beheaded, which is this folder — three hundred, counted and unnamed, all beheaded, as saint.gr keeps them on its 7 Δεκεμβρίου, and the word мирјана confirms the bare `martyr` this folder holds against the `presbyter` of the other two groups. The company heading „Свети мученици у Африци.“ is quoted whole on each of the three folders and is a true description of each. NO `sr` NAME FORM: the heading holds no personal name and its one company designation belongs to all three groups at once. `types` UNTOUCHED. `dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THIS IS THE ONE OF THE THREE WHERE THE TWO BOOKS DO NOT DISAGREE: this folder already carries 474–491 for Zeno’s whole reign, which CONTAINS the «(477-484)» this book brackets for the Vandal king, so there was nothing to widen; the display stays «under Zeno», which is the only ruler saint.gr names here, and the Vandal king is recorded in the life. NO `locations`: both books say Africa for these three hundred. NO `related` row: neither book names one of them, and the two Monophysite bishops saint.gr blames for the persecution are no folders this corpus holds. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
